pre_read_code.powershell: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "./cheaper.ps1" hook pre-read-code --target windsurf; exit $LASTEXITCODE

pre_run_command.powershell: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "./cheaper.ps1" hook pre-run-command --target windsurf; exit $LASTEXITCODE

preToolUse.powershell: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "./cheaper.ps1" hook pre-tool-use --target copilot; exit 0

beforeReadFile.powershell: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "./cheaper.ps1" hook before-read-file --target cursor; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { '{"permission":"allow"}' }; exit 0

beforeShellExecution.powershell: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "./cheaper.ps1" hook before-shell-execution --target cursor; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { '{"permission":"allow"}' }; exit 0
